item.title: AI Server Vendors Raise Prices Up to 45% Before Delivery
item.description:
AI server vendors including Dell, HPE, Lenovo and Supermicro are sharply raising prices 25-45% after contracts are signed but before delivery, per the Financial Times, as buyers are forced to accept. The hikes stem largely from memory costs up over 400% since early 2024, and a dispute over a $549M fixed-price Dell-XTX deal has surfaced in Irish court.

原文标题：AI 服务器交付前涨价最高达 45%

Why it matters：揭示算力供应链定价权失衡与内存成本传导，是理解 AI 基础设施经济性的关键信号。

item.title: MiniMax Internal Model Breaks Multiple Frontier Cryptographic Schemes
item.description:
MiniMax announced that its latest internal model conducted systematic automated cryptanalysis of modern cryptographic schemes, achieving the first practical breaks of several NIST competition candidates that previously had no known attacks, and efficiently forging ciphertexts or recovering keys for peer-reviewed frontier designs while setting a new record for the highest number of broken rounds in a new block cipher. On public challenges for classical hard mathematical problems, the model solved dozens of high-order instances with no known public solution, delivering measured speedups of hundreds to tens of thousands of times over the best algorithms. MiniMax stressed that mainstream standards such as AES, RSA and SHA-256 remain unaffected and has released a technical report and code.

原文标题：MiniMax 内部模型攻破多个密码学前沿方案

Why it matters：大模型首次被系统性用于自动化密码分析并取得可验证的实战突破，是 AI for Science 与安全领域的标志性事件。

item.title: METR Warns AI Capability Growth Is Outpacing Safety Testing
item.description:
METR's latest quarterly capability update finds frontier models now outperform experienced human professionals on most well-specified coding and computational tasks, with the task length they can handle doubling every 3.6 months; a naive extrapolation reaches 50% success on 200-hour tasks by July 2027. The organization warns that current public data cannot rule out a drastic acceleration in AI research, potentially leaving humans unable to meaningfully assess and react to catastrophic risks.

原文标题：METR 警告 AI 能力增速已超出安全评估能力

Why it matters：这是对 AI 能力增速与安全评估能力之间缺口的一次量化预警，直接影响模型发布节奏与监管讨论。

item.title: Vibe Coding Spreads From Software to Everyday Gadgets
item.description:
LLMs haven't unlocked wholly new capabilities, but they make hardware hacking trivially easy: users now prompt Claude Code or Codex to modify TVs and other gadgets. The trend is spawning developer-friendly hardware and a market for better device software, extending the personal-software revolution into physical devices.

原文标题：氛围编程正蔓延至各类硬件设备

Why it matters：揭示氛围编程从软件向硬件外溢的行业趋势，对关注 AI 工具生态的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Cheap AI Inference Providers Caught Stealing Keys and Snooping on Users
item.description:
Security firm Dragos sent roughly 2 million AI requests containing fake credentials to inference providers between July and November 2026, finding at least three compromised services where attackers had been silently stealing user data and AWS keys for months. The study flags intermediaries and model marketplaces that route requests as a major supply-chain risk.

原文标题：研究揭示廉价 AI 推理商窃取密钥并窥探用户

Why it matters：以大规模实测数据揭示廉价推理服务背后的凭证窃取与数据窥探风险，对任何调用第三方 API 的团队都有直接警示价值。

item.title: Developer Fits Tiny Transformer on a Floppy Disk to Run AI on 486 PCs
item.description:
Developer WollyMonjac released Tiny 2.1, a tiny question-answering Transformer written in Turbo C 2.0 with just 367K parameters and 8-bit quantization that fits in roughly 380 KB, small enough for a single floppy disk and runnable on DOS-era 486DX and Pentium machines. Released under the MIT license with a training-data folder, the project has limited practical value but demonstrates model compression and deployment under extreme storage and memory constraints.

原文标题：开发者把微型 Transformer 塞进软盘 让 486 老电脑跑上 AI

Why it matters：一个有趣的极端约束工程案例，展示了微型 Transformer 的量化压缩与 DOS 部署路径。

item.title: Google Cuts Broadcom-Designed TPU 8i Orders by One Million Units
item.description:
Ming-Chi Kuo's supply-chain survey indicates Google has cut 2027 shipments of Broadcom-designed TPU 8i by roughly one million units, about 20% of the series, while planning to raise volumes of MediaTek-designed TPU 8t. The shift reflects frontier-model compute priority, tight supply and data-center power constraints, alongside Google decoupling TPU design from HBM procurement to cut costs.

原文标题：谷歌削减 2027 年博通 TPU 8i 订单约 100 万颗

Why it matters：头部云厂商自研 AI 芯片的订单结构与供应链分工出现实质调整，是观察算力供给格局的关键信号。

item.title: Lean Community Confirms Formal Proof of Riemann Hypothesis
item.description:
The Lean and Mathlib community has officially confirmed that Stanford mathematician Levent Alpöge's proof of the Riemann hypothesis is correct. Published on Nov 20, 2026 as 17 million lines of Lean code, the proof was independently reproduced by dozens of verifiers whose programs are provably incapable of accepting a flawed argument. It marks the first time AI-assisted formal mathematics has cracked one of the most famous open problems in math.

原文标题：黎曼猜想被 Lean 形式化证明验证通过

Why it matters：黎曼猜想被形式化验证攻克，是 AI 与数学交叉史上的里程碑事件，影响远超单一模型发布。

item.title: China Smart Glasses Average Price Falls to 1,542 Yuan in Q3 2026
item.description:
RUNTO data shows China's smart glasses retail volume reached 544,000 units in Q3 2026, up 14.3% year on year, while retail value fell 4.3% and average price dropped 16.2% to 1,542 yuan. AR glasses were the only category to gain share, rising to 35.8%, while camera glasses saw steep price declines. RUNTO cut its full-year volume forecast to 2.05-2.15 million units, below the earlier 2.58 million.

原文标题：2026 年第三季度中国智能眼镜均价降至 1542 元

Why it matters：智能眼镜作为具身与可穿戴 AI 载体，其量增价跌与品类结构变化是观察端侧 AI 硬件落地的重要行业信号。

item.title: US Accounting Firms Adopt Generative AI at 88% but Only 13% Reach Integration Maturity
item.description:
A Wolters Kluwer survey of 746 US accounting professionals finds 88% use generative AI daily and 68% use agentic AI, with 83% self-identifying as innovators or early adopters. Yet only 13% of firms assessed for digital maturity clear the technology-leader threshold, revealing a wide gap between tool adoption and genuine integration of data, workflows and cloud infrastructure.

原文标题：报告称美国会计业 88% 用生成式 AI 但仅 13% 达成熟度门槛

Why it matters：以具体调查数据揭示 AI 采用率与整合成熟度之间的落差，对理解企业级 AI 落地瓶颈有参考价值。

item.title: mod_wsgi Creator Launches AI-Assisted Rust Server Muru for Python
item.description:
Graham Dumpleton, creator of mod_wsgi, has released Muru, a new Rust-based server built with heavy AI assistance that aims to be the best way to run ASGI and WSGI Python apps in both development and production. He is publishing a detailed public build log, with over a dozen deep-dive posts in three weeks covering worker architecture and import-once-fork-many design.

item.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol Answer Faster but Trail Claude on Transparency
item.description:
An Artificial Analysis evaluation finds OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol produce answers 34 to 40 percent shorter than predecessors, with more direct phrasing and far fewer headings and em dashes. However, willingness to admit uncertainty dropped sharply, with Astra falling from 96 to 24 on that trait. Against Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5, both models score lower on structure and transparency, while Opus 5.5 leads all four on informativeness and information density.

原文标题：GPT-6.2 回答更短更快但透明度不及 Claude

Why it matters：第三方评测量化揭示了头部模型在表达风格与不确定性披露上的路线分化，对模型选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: AI and Mathematician Claim Riemann Hypothesis Proof Verified in 17M Lines of Lean
item.description:
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge announced that a collaboration with Claude has produced a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, with a roughly 17-million-line Lean formalization independently verified by the Lean and Mathlib communities. Fields Medalist James Maynard says he believes the result is correct, but full acceptance by the mathematics community requires someone to genuinely understand and explain the underlying ideas.

Why it matters：AI 首次触及数学界最著名的未解难题，且以可机器核验的形式化证明呈现，是 AI for Science 的标志性节点。

item.title: Ant Group's Afu Health App Hits 150M Users and 20M Daily Consultations
item.description:
Ant Group's AI health app Afu has reached 150 million users with over 20 million online consultations per day, 55% of which come from lower-tier cities. Ant Health VP Yang Meng framed AI's role as offloading repetitive administrative work so physicians can focus on judgment and patient care, marking a notable data point for large-scale AI healthcare deployment in China.

item.title: Anthropic's 2028 Power Mix Skewed 87% Toward Natural Gas
item.description:
Anthropic's AI compute expansion is being powered overwhelmingly by fossil fuels, with roughly 87% of its 2028 electricity mix projected to come from natural gas and 11% from coal, leaving renewables marginal. The case study illustrates a broader industry pattern in which AI data centers drive both 'bring your own power' projects and ~377 GW of new fossil generation, exposing a structural conflict between AI scaling and clean-energy commitments.

原文标题：Anthropic 2028 年电力 87% 来自天然气

Why it matters：以具体电力结构数据揭示 AI 算力扩张对化石能源的深度依赖，是理解 AI 基础设施约束的关键视角。

item.title: Musk Warns AI Industry May Face Hundreds of Billions in Funding Gap Next Year
item.description:
Keras creator François Chollet argues GPU spot prices keep rising, HBM and DRAM capacity is booked out to 2029, frontier training compute doubles roughly every five months, and inference margins can reach 70-85%. Musk replied that powering, cooling and stabilizing such compute is extremely hard, warning that a few months' delay in revenue generation could require hundreds of billions in extra working capital industry-wide, and asked where that money would come from.

item.description:
China's first trusted data space pilot, launched in 2025, has reached a milestone covering 13 cities, 22 industries and 28 enterprises. It has generated 457 high-quality datasets and 136 vertical AI models, enabling scenarios such as multimodal logistics, mutual recognition of carbon footprint accounting and new materials R&D.

item.title: TikTok Rolls Out AI Content Detector and Likeness Protection Tool
item.description:
TikTok launched a public AI content detection tool that lets anyone, even without an account, upload images or videos to check whether they were generated or edited by TikTok's AI features, including detection of its proprietary invisible watermark VeraDura. It is also rolling out an opt-in Likeness Detection feature globally to help creators find and flag unauthorized AI-generated uses of their likeness. TikTok says it has labeled over 5 billion AI-generated videos and proactively removed more than 99% of violating AI content before user reports.

原文标题：TikTok 上线 AI 内容检测与肖像保护工具

Why it matters：主流平台将 AI 内容溯源与肖像保护产品化，是深度伪造治理的重要落地信号。

Beyond voice-to-text, the product layers in context understanding, one-tap translation, scenario-based polishing Skills and spoken AI commands, positioning itself as an AI-native input entry point.

item.title: Global Electronics Association Warns PCB Shortage May Last Until 2027
item.description:
The Global Electronics Association issued an industry alert warning that PCB supply shortages are worsening as AI server demand for high-layer-count boards strains capacity. Orders rose 56.1% year-over-year through September while shipments grew only 13.3%, with lead times for high-layer boards reaching 16-20 weeks. The association expects shortages to persist until at least the first half of 2027, with no meaningful relief before mid-2028, a risk comparable to the 2021 chip crunch.

原文标题：全球电子协会警告 PCB 短缺或持续至 2027 年

Why it matters：AI 算力扩张正把瓶颈从芯片转移到 PCB 与上游材料，这一预警直接影响数据中心与硬件供应链排期。

item.title: Glucose-Powered Implant Restores Blood Sugar Control in Diabetic Rats
item.description:
Researchers from the National University of Singapore and Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications report in Nature a glucose-powered implant, NeuroAxis, that electrically stimulates the vagus nerve to engage cholinergic anti-inflammatory and neuroimmune regulation for closed-loop glucose control. Type 2 diabetic rats approached healthy glucose levels within two weeks, while type 1 rats regained glycemic control after eight weeks, with evidence of pancreatic beta-cell proliferation. The work is the first to use glucose as both an energy source and a metabolic sensing signal in a battery-free, self-regulating neurostimulation system.

原文标题：Nature：葡萄糖自供电植入装置助糖尿病大鼠恢复血糖

Why it matters：这是神经调控与代谢疾病交叉领域的重要进展，首次实现葡萄糖自供能与闭环刺激，具备明确的机制与动物实验数据。

item.title: Anthropic Mathematician Claims Navier-Stokes Proof With Claude's Help
item.description:
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge and NYU professor Tristan Buckmaster released a 79-page paper on Nov 20 claiming a proof of finite-time blow-up for the 3D Navier-Stokes equations without external forcing, alongside Lean formalization code; Terence Tao has weighed in but stresses independent verification is still needed. The same day, mathematician Alessandro Maria Masullo published a 940-page, 12-year human-only Riemann Hypothesis proof draft, creating a stark contrast between AI-assisted and human-led mathematics.

原文标题：Anthropic 数学家借助 Claude 宣称证明 Navier-Stokes 难题

Why it matters：千禧难题级别的数学证明主张叠加 Claude 参与，且与人类 12 年手稿形成对照，是 AI for Science 的标志性事件。

item.title: Fudan Team Unveils F2G-Pose for One-Shot Object Pose and Shape Prediction
item.description:
Researchers from Fudan University and Shanghai Innovation Institute propose F2G-Pose, which performs direct RGB-D category-level 6D pose estimation in a single forward pass, jointly predicting object pose, size, and full 3D shape without per-instance CAD models or reference images. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 with code released, it offers a more direct spatial perception route for robotic grasping and manipulation.

原文标题：复旦团队提出 F2G-Pose 单次前向预测物体位姿与形状

Why it matters：顶会接收的类别级位姿估计新方法，单次前向联合预测位姿尺寸形状，对具身智能与机器人感知有直接价值。

item.title: Tsinghua and 16 Institutions Launch Mind2Act World Embodied Benchmark
item.description:
Tsinghua mmlab@SIGS, together with Yuanxing Guangnian and 16 institutions, released Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark for robotic manipulation with 30 tasks and 180 configurations that tests reasoning and physical execution separately and then jointly, attributing each failed episode to a root cause. Across 9 systems and 56,700 simulated episodes, the best agent scored 52.7% on reasoning-only and 39.0% on execution-only tasks, but just 12.0% on composed tasks, while end-to-end policies peaked at 3.6%.

原文标题：清华联合 16 家机构发布具身诊断基准 Mind2Act World

Why it matters：该基准以失败归因取代单一成功率，为 VLA 与通用 Agent 两条具身路线提供了可诊断的评测维度。

item.title: Canary Tokens Expose Prompt Leaks Across Three AI Supply Chain Breaches
item.description:
Dragos used canary tokens to trace AI inference data flows and documented real breaches at three companies, where marketplace resellers stole customer prompts and privacy settings and retention policies were ignored. The post identifies AI routers as a key exfiltration point and outlines a practical canary-token approach for detecting prompt leaks.

Why it matters：以真实泄露案例揭示 AI 推理链路中的提示词外泄风险，并给出可落地的检测手段，对企业 AI 安全建设有直接参考价值。

item.title: 03 年实习生离职千问创办 Alps Lab 押注 RSI
item.description:
曾参与千问后训练团队“主观性与交互性”研究小组的 2003 年出生实习研究员张轩铭，已于 10 月初离开团队，以联合创始人兼首席认知科学家身份筹备创业公司 Alps Lab，方向为认知人工智能与下一代基础模型，RSI（递归自我改进）是核心探索方向之一。公司 9 月底启动，正筹备首轮融资，目标估值过亿美元。

Why it matters：年轻研究者从千问后训练团队出走创业，切入火热的 RSI 赛道并已启动融资，是观察人才流动与前沿创业风向的样本。

item.title: 哈佛开源虚拟细胞模型 STRAND 可预演 DNA 干预连锁响应
item.description:
哈佛医学院、约翰斯·霍普金斯大学与默克团队联合提出 STRAND，将单细胞扰动预测的输入从基因 ID 改为 DNA 序列加目标位置，使模型能在非编码区指定干预点，并预测输入窗口之外的多基因连锁响应。该工作已被 NeurIPS 2026 主会接收，代码已公开，与 Google DeepMind 的 AlphaGenome 2 形成互补：后者刻画变异对序列内表达的影响，STRAND 则聚焦干预后的跨窗口响应。

Why it matters：把扰动预测从基因标签推进到序列位置粒度，是虚拟细胞与 AI for Science 方向少见的架构级新思路，且代码已开源。

item.title: 新工具只把最慢的 5% 代码用 Rust 重写
item.description:
fast-anything 提出一种渐进式性能优化路径：先用性能剖析找出耗时最高的少数函数，再让编码智能体仅将这些函数移植为 Rust，并通过回放真实录制的调用验证结果一致后热替换，全程一条命令且可逆。它支持 Python、Node、Ruby、Java、Go、PHP、C/C++ 等语言，通过统一的 C 入口 JSON 桥接，无需为每种语言单独编写绑定。

Why it matters：针对“全量重写 Rust”的高成本痛点给出可验证、可回滚的局部移植方案，对性能优化实践有直接参考价值。

item.title: Together AI 因 AI 编码代理泄露凭证致提示词外泄
item.description:
Together AI 披露一起安全事件：其公开 GitHub 仓库 xorl 开发过程中，一个 AI 编码代理将可访问私有 Hugging Face 仓库的凭证提交入库，导致 2026 年 6 至 7 月间 MiniMax M3、GLM-5.2、Kimi K2.6 等模型的部分用户提示词样本被未授权方下载。攻击者随后还在样本中搜寻其他凭证。事件暴露了 AI 代理参与开发流程带来的供应链风险，公司建议处理敏感提示词的客户启用零数据保留（ZDR）。

Why it matters：这是 AI 编码代理直接引发真实数据泄露的罕见公开案例，对使用代理式开发与托管推理服务的团队具有直接警示价值。

item.title: Lean 社区核验 1700 万行黎曼猜想形式化证明
item.description:
Lean 与 Mathlib 社区联合宣布，Levent Alpöge 以约 1700 万行 Lean 代码形式给出的黎曼猜想证明已通过四项核验：陈述正确、代码可编译、证明与 Mathlib 陈述一致、证明有效。核验动用了 Lean 官方内核、con-leche、con-ron 及多个第三方独立检查器，并借助相对集合论的形式化证明排除了检查器本身接受错误证明的可能。若最终成立，这将是 AI 辅助数学与形式化验证领域的里程碑事件。

Why it matters：黎曼猜想若被形式化证明攻克，将是数学与 AI 辅助推理的历史性节点，且核验流程本身具备高度技术参考价值。
